name: Workday HCM and Financials
certifications: Workday partner certifications (such as Core HCM, Integrations, Reporting and Financials)
tools: Workday Web Services and REST APIs

beginner.summary: For HR, finance and HRIS staff and new consultants who are starting with Workday. Covers the object model, tenants and twice-yearly releases, navigation, supervisory and other organisations, staffing models, workers and job profiles, business processes, hire, job change and termination, compensation, absence and time tracking, benefits, recruiting and onboarding, talent and performance, security groups and policies, Report Writer, calculated fields, dashboards, Financials core with worktags, EIB loads and release management.
prerequisites: Understands basic HR or finance processes
Comfortable with web applications and spreadsheets
outcomes: Navigate Workday and explain its object model, organisations and staffing models
Run and adjust core HR business processes, compensation, absence and recruiting
Build reports, calculated fields and dashboards and load data with EIB
Explain Workday security and the release cycle

days.topic: Workday Overview: Object Model, Tenants and the Twice-Yearly Releases
subtopics: Workday as one cloud system for HR and finance
The object model: business objects, fields and instances
Tenants: production, sandbox, preview and implementation
Releases twice a year and weekly service updates
HCM, Financials, Payroll and Adaptive Planning
Certification routes for customers and partners
Course project overview: a company moving HR and finance to Workday
days.lab_task: Tour a Workday training tenant, find a worker, an organisation and a business process, read one release note and map the course company's needs to Workday products.
days.deliverable: Product map for the course company
checks: A worker, an organisation and a business process are located
Needed Workday products are listed with reasons
Tenant types and the release cycle are explained correctly

days.topic: Navigation Basics: Home, Search, Worklets and Related Actions
subtopics: The Workday home page and apps
Related actions and the related actions menu
days.lab_task: Find a worker with search prefixes, act on an inbox task, use related actions to view the worker's history and set up a delegation.
checks: The worker is found with a search prefix
The delegation routes tasks to the delegate

days.topic: Organisations: Supervisory, Company, Cost Centre and Matrix
subtopics: Supervisory organisations as the core structure
Organisation design for the course company
days.lab_task: Build supervisory organisations, companies and cost centres for the course company, assign organisation roles and view the org chart.
checks: Managers and HR partners are assigned
Workers inherit company and cost centre

days.topic: Staffing Models: Position Management and Job Management
subtopics: Choosing a staffing model per organisation
days.lab_task: Set position management for one organisation and job management for another, create positions with restrictions and compare hiring in each.
checks: Each organisation uses its staffing model
Position restrictions limit hires as expected
Differences between the models are listed

days.topic: Workers, Jobs and Job Profiles
days.lab_task: Create job profiles and families, hire an employee and a contingent worker, add an additional job and update personal data through self-service.

days.topic: Business Processes: Definitions, Steps and Approvals
days.lab_task: Edit the hire business process to add an approval with a condition, a to-do and a notification, test it with two hires and read the process history.
checks: The new steps appear in the definition
The approval runs only when the condition is met
The notification reaches the right role

days.topic: Hire, Change Job and Termination Processes
subtopics: Change job for promotions and transfers
Edit position and change organisation assignments
days.lab_task: Run a hire with onboarding, a promotion through change job, a transfer, a termination and a rescind, and review the history of each.
checks: Onboarding tasks are created for the new hire
Promotion and transfer update the job
The rescinded process leaves a clean history

days.topic: Compensation: Plans, Grades and Eligibility Rules
subtopics: Compensation packages, grades and grade profiles
Compensation in hire and change job
days.lab_task: Create grades, a salary plan and an allowance plan with eligibility rules, apply them in a hire and change compensation for an existing worker.
checks: Grades and plans follow the design
Eligibility rules include and exclude the right workers

days.topic: Absence and Time Tracking
subtopics: Time off plans and leave of absence
Time entry codes and time blocks
days.lab_task: Configure a time off plan with accruals, request time off, enter a week of time with overtime and approve both as the manager.
checks: The manager approves time and absence

days.topic: Benefits: Plans, Enrolment Events and Carriers
days.lab_task: Configure a medical and a life plan, run a new hire enrolment and a life event with a dependant, and check the costs.
checks: Plans and costs follow the design
Employee and employer costs are correct

days.topic: Recruiting and Onboarding
days.lab_task: Create a requisition, post it, move a candidate through screening and interviews, make an offer, hire the candidate and run onboarding.
days.deliverable: Recruiting trail from requisition to onboarding
checks: The job appears on the career site
The candidate moves through each stage
The hired candidate gets onboarding tasks

days.topic: Talent and Performance
days.lab_task: Set goals, run a performance review with self and manager steps, hold a talent review with a nine-box grid and name a successor.
checks: The performance review completes all steps
Workers are placed on the nine-box grid
A successor is named for a key position

days.topic: Security: Security Groups, Domains and Business Process Policies
days.lab_task: Create a role-based security group for HR partners, grant it domain and business process permissions, activate the changes and test what a user can do.
checks: The group has the intended members
The user can do only allowed tasks

days.topic: Reporting with Report Writer: Data Sources, Fields and Filters
days.lab_task: Build an advanced report of workers by organisation with job and pay data, add prompts and filters, and share it with HR partners.
checks: Prompts and filters narrow the results
Only HR partners can run it

days.topic: Calculated Fields
days.lab_task: Build calculated fields for tenure in years, a flag for workers without a manager and the count of direct reports, and use them in a report.
days.deliverable: Calculated fields used in a report
checks: Tenure is correct for sample workers
Workers without a manager are flagged
Direct report counts match the org chart

days.topic: Dashboards, Worklets and Discovery Boards
days.lab_task: Build a manager dashboard with headcount and absence worklets and a discovery board that analyses turnover by organisation.
checks: The dashboard shows headcount and absence
The discovery board shows turnover by organisation

days.topic: Workday Financials Core: Worktags, Accounting, Suppliers and Customers
subtopics: Companies, ledgers and the account set
days.lab_task: Create worktags for the course company, enter a journal, process a supplier invoice and a customer invoice to settlement and run a trial balance.
days.deliverable: Financial transactions with a trial balance
checks: Supplier and customer invoices are settled

days.topic: EIB for Mass Data Loads
days.lab_task: Load job profiles and compensation changes with inbound EIBs, fix the errors, and schedule an outbound EIB that sends workers to a file.
days.deliverable: Inbound loads and a scheduled outbound EIB
checks: The outbound file contains the right workers

days.topic: Release Management: Sandbox, Preview and Production Tenants
subtopics: Release notes and the feature release guide
days.lab_task: Review the next feature release for the course modules, choose opt-in features, test five scenarios in the preview tenant and plan communication.
days.deliverable: Release review with tests and communication plan
checks: Relevant features are listed with impact
Five scenarios are tested in preview

days.topic: Beginner Capstone: Hire-to-Pay Walkthrough in a Workday Tenant
days.lab_task: Run hire-to-pay for the course company with organisations, a hire with compensation and benefits, absence and time, an EIB load and a dashboard of results.
checks: The hire-to-pay steps complete without errors
Each step is done by a user with the right role

intermediate.summary: For HRIS analysts, Workday administrators and consultants who configure and integrate Workday. Covers business process design, compensation cycles, payroll, security in depth, advanced and composite reports, calculated fields in depth, Core Connectors and Document Transformation, Workday Studio, web services, REST APIs and Reports as a Service, Prism Analytics, Financials configuration, procurement and expenses, Workday Extend, Workday Build and custom agents, Workday Illuminate and agents, tenant management, release testing, data conversion and certification paths.
prerequisites: Has used Workday as an administrator, analyst or key user
Understands Workday business processes, security and reports
Comfortable with XML or JSON for integration work
outcomes: Configure business processes, compensation, payroll and security to requirements
Build complex reports, Prism datasets and integrations with connectors, Studio and APIs
Extend Workday with Extend, Workday Build and agents
Manage tenants, releases and data conversion and choose the right certification

days.topic: Business Process Design: Conditions, Sub-Processes and Notifications
days.lab_task: Redesign the change job process for two countries with condition rules, a parallel approval, an escalation and notifications, and test six cases.
checks: Each case follows the expected route

days.topic: Compensation Cycles: Merit, Bonus and Stock Plans
days.lab_task: Configure a merit and bonus cycle with budgets, run it as two managers, calibrate results and produce statements.
checks: Plans and budgets follow the design

days.topic: Workday Payroll: Pay Groups, Earnings, Deductions and Pay Runs
days.lab_task: Configure an earning and a deduction, run a pay calculation for a pay group, audit the results, process a retro change and post payroll accounting.
checks: Pay results are correct for test workers
The retro change pays the difference
Payroll accounting posts to the ledger

days.topic: Security Configuration in Depth: Role-Based, User-Based and Intersection Groups
subtopics: Domain and business process policy design
days.lab_task: Design security for HR partners by country with intersection groups, restrict pay data with segments, give an integration user minimal access and test with proxy.
checks: HR partners see only their country's workers
Pay data is hidden from unauthorised users
The integration user has only needed domains

days.topic: Advanced Reports: Composite, Matrix and Trending Reports
days.lab_task: Build a matrix report of headcount by organisation and grade, a trending report of turnover and a composite report for the board, and tune a slow report.
days.deliverable: Three reports and a tuned report
checks: Matrix, trending and composite reports return correct data
The composite report joins its sub-reports correctly

days.topic: Calculated Fields in Depth: Lookups, Evaluations and Performance
subtopics: Calculated fields in business process conditions
days.lab_task: Build nested calculated fields for pay band position and pending actions, use one in a business process condition and document them to the standard.
checks: The process condition uses the field correctly

days.topic: Integrations with Core Connectors and Document Transformation
days.lab_task: Build a Core Connector: Worker integration with changes-only output, transform it to a vendor's CSV format with Document Transformation and schedule it.
checks: The vendor file matches the specification

days.topic: Workday Studio: Assemblies, Web Services and Error Handling
days.lab_task: Build a Studio integration that reads a vendor file, validates rows, creates workers through web services and reports errors without stopping the run.
checks: Invalid rows are reported without stopping the run
The integration runs in the tenant

days.topic: Workday Web Services, REST APIs and Reports as a Service
subtopics: Authentication with integration system users and OAuth
days.lab_task: Call a SOAP operation and a REST endpoint with OAuth, expose a report as a service in JSON and build a small feed from it.
days.deliverable: API calls and a RaaS feed
checks: SOAP and REST calls return data
The report returns JSON as a service
The API client has only needed scopes

days.topic: Prism Analytics: Datasets, Data Change Tasks and Publishing
days.lab_task: Load an external engagement survey file into Prism, blend it with worker data, publish it and report engagement by organisation.
days.deliverable: Published Prism data source with a report
checks: The survey file loads into a table
Survey and worker data join correctly
The report shows engagement by organisation

days.topic: Workday Financials Configuration: Ledgers, Account Posting Rules and Close
days.lab_task: Configure account posting rules and worktag defaults, set up intercompany and an allocation, run a period close and a consolidated report.
days.deliverable: Financials configuration with a closed period
checks: Transactions post to the right accounts

days.topic: Procurement and Expenses in Workday
days.lab_task: Configure spend categories and an expense policy, run a requisition to invoice match and an expense report with a card transaction, and report spend.
days.deliverable: Procurement and expense trail with a spend report
checks: The requisition becomes a matched invoice
The expense report follows the policy

days.topic: Workday Extend: App Builder, Orchestrations and Model Components
days.lab_task: Build an Extend app for equipment requests with a custom business object, a page and an orchestration that notifies IT, and deploy it.
checks: Requests are stored in the custom object
Only intended users can use the app

days.topic: Workday Build and Custom Agents: Developer Tools for AI Apps
subtopics: Workday Build as the developer platform
Building custom agents that run on Workday
Connecting agents to Workday data and actions
Using familiar agent frameworks with Workday
When to build or use delivered agents
days.lab_task: Build a custom agent that answers policy questions and creates time off requests through Workday actions, verify it against test cases and deploy it.
checks: The agent answers and acts through Workday
The agent cannot act beyond the user's permissions

days.topic: Workday AI: Illuminate, Delivered Agents and the Agent System of Record
subtopics: Delivered agents for HR and finance
days.lab_task: Use two delivered agents on sample tasks, register an agent in the Agent System of Record with its permissions and define human review steps.
checks: The agent is recorded with owner and permissions

days.topic: Tenant Management: Object Transporter, Refreshes and Configuration Moves
days.lab_task: Move a business process change and a report from sandbox to production with Object Transporter, track it in a change log and check data masking in sandbox.
days.deliverable: Configuration move with a change log
checks: Changes arrive in the target tenant
The change log records what moved and why
Sensitive data is masked in sandbox

days.topic: Testing Workday Releases: Feature Review and Regression Testing
days.lab_task: Build a risk-based regression plan for the next feature release, run it in preview including two integrations, log defects and sign off.

days.topic: Data Conversion for Workday Implementations: Mock Loads and Validation
days.lab_task: Run a mock conversion of workers, positions and compensation, reconcile counts and pay totals with the source and present results to the data owners.
checks: Counts and pay totals match the source
Data owners accept or reject with reasons

days.topic: Workday Certification Paths: Partner Certifications and Workday Pro
subtopics: Mapping course days to certification topics
days.lab_task: Choose the right certification for your role, complete practice tasks in a tenant, map gaps to course days and write a study plan.
checks: The study plan covers the gaps

days.topic: Intermediate Capstone: Configured Workday HCM Pilot with Integrations and Reports
days.lab_task: Deliver a pilot for the course company with redesigned processes, a compensation cycle, payroll, country security, two integrations, a RaaS feed, Prism reporting and an agent, and present it to the steering group persona.
checks: Processes, pay and security work as designed
Integrations and feeds run without errors
Reports and Prism data answer the steering questions

advanced.summary: For Workday architects, programme leads and senior consultants. Covers programme architecture, global deployments, security architecture and audits, integration architecture, mass organisation changes, workforce planning, people analytics, financial close and Adaptive Planning, Extend at enterprise scale, AI agent governance, release strategy, data privacy, mergers and acquisitions, moves from SAP HCM, Oracle or PeopleSoft, payroll partners, performance and volume, post-go-live support, a centre of excellence and change management.
prerequisites: Has delivered or run at least one Workday deployment
Understands Workday configuration, security, integrations and reporting
Responsible for design, programme or architecture decisions
outcomes: Design global Workday programmes with security, integration and data architectures
Run mass changes, planning, analytics and releases at scale
Govern Extend apps, agents and privacy
Lead migrations, mergers, support and change

days.topic: Workday Programme Architecture: Global Design, Integrations and Data
subtopics: Solution architecture for HCM and Financials
days.lab_task: Design the Workday architecture for a multinational with HCM, Payroll partners and Financials, and defend it to a design authority.
checks: Products, integrations and data flows are shown
Key decisions are recorded with options
The design authority accepts the design with actions

days.topic: Global Deployments: Localisation, Country Requirements and Rollout Waves
subtopics: Data residency and privacy by country
days.lab_task: Design a global template with variations for three countries, plan works council consultation and data privacy needs and schedule the rollout waves.
checks: Global and local elements are separated

days.topic: Security Architecture and Audits: Segregation of Duties and Policy Reviews
days.lab_task: Design the security model for the programme, find segregation of duties conflicts, run an access review and prepare audit evidence.
checks: Groups and policies cover all roles with least privilege
The audit pack answers auditor questions

days.topic: Integration Architecture at Scale: Patterns, Monitoring and Recovery
days.lab_task: Design the integration architecture for forty interfaces with patterns, owners and monitoring, and run a recovery drill for a failed payroll interface.
checks: Each interface has a pattern and owner
Failures raise alerts to the support team
The failed interface is reprocessed correctly

days.topic: Organisation Change at Scale: Reorganisations and Mass Job Changes
subtopics: Mass operations for organisations and jobs
days.lab_task: Plan a reorganisation of 2,000 workers, run it in sandbox with mass job changes and validation, check security impacts and plan the production run.
checks: The mass change completes in sandbox
Security and approvals still route correctly
The production run has timing and rollback steps

days.topic: Workforce Planning and Headcount Management
days.lab_task: Build a headcount plan with two scenarios, link approved positions to recruiting and report plan against actual for a quarter.

days.topic: People Analytics: Prism, Discovery Boards and Executive Dashboards
days.lab_task: Define ten people metrics, build an executive dashboard with Prism data, add data quality checks and present insights to the leadership persona.
checks: Data quality checks flag seeded problems

days.topic: Financial Close, Consolidation and Planning with Adaptive Planning
days.lab_task: Run a multi-company close with intercompany eliminations, load actuals into an Adaptive Planning model and report forecast against actual.
checks: Actuals arrive in the planning model

days.topic: Workday Extend at Enterprise Scale: App Governance, Security and Lifecycle
days.lab_task: Set standards and a review process for Extend apps, run two apps through the process and plan their maintenance through the next release.
days.deliverable: App governance process with reviewed apps
checks: Standards cover security, testing and support

days.topic: AI Agent Governance in Workday: Permissions, Audit and Responsible AI
subtopics: Delivered and custom agents in one register
days.lab_task: Write an AI agent policy for HR and finance, apply permissions and approvals to three agents and review a month of seeded agent actions for errors and bias.
checks: The policy defines roles, approvals and audit
Seeded errors and bias are found and acted on

days.topic: Release Strategy at Scale: Feature Adoption and Governance
days.lab_task: Run release governance for the next feature release across HCM and Financials with impact analysis, an adoption roadmap and a communication plan.
checks: Features are scheduled on the roadmap
Each audience gets the right message

days.topic: Data Privacy in Workday: GDPR, Retention and Purging
days.lab_task: Define retention rules for three data types, run a purge in sandbox, answer a subject access request and prepare privacy audit evidence.
days.deliverable: Retention rules, purge record and audit evidence
checks: Retention rules cover the data types
The subject access request is complete

days.topic: Mergers and Acquisitions: Bringing Acquired Companies into Workday
subtopics: Security and access for new staff
days.lab_task: Plan the integration of a 500-person acquisition with day-one access, organisation mapping, conversion and payroll transition, and a divestiture data split.
checks: A mock conversion loads the acquired workers
Divested data is identified and separated

days.topic: Moving from SAP HCM, Oracle or PeopleSoft to Workday
days.lab_task: Assess a SAP HCM estate for a move to Workday, decide on history, reports and interfaces, and plan coexistence and decommissioning.
checks: History and coexistence decisions are recorded

days.topic: Payroll Partner Integrations: Cloud Connect, PECI and Third-Party Payroll
days.lab_task: Configure a payroll effective change interface for a partner, run two pay periods with changes, load results back and reconcile with the partner.

days.topic: Performance and Volume: Large Reports, Integrations and Process Load
subtopics: Business process load at peak periods
Working with Workday Support on performance
days.lab_task: Measure performance during a seeded open enrolment peak, tune the slowest report and integration, and plan schedules that avoid overlaps.
days.deliverable: Performance report with tuning and schedule plan

days.topic: Post-Go-Live Support Model and Application Management Services
days.lab_task: Design the post-go-live support model with service levels, raise a well-formed support case for a seeded issue and set up an improvement backlog.
checks: Tiers and service levels are defined
The support case has all needed details
The backlog is ranked by value

days.topic: Workday Centre of Excellence and Roadmap
days.lab_task: Design a Workday centre of excellence with roles, intake and a twelve-month roadmap, and report value against the business case.
days.deliverable: Centre of excellence plan and value report
checks: Value is measured against the business case
objectives: Run a Workday centre of excellence

days.topic: Change Management and Adoption for Workday Programmes
days.lab_task: Build a change impact analysis and training plan for managers and employees, design the champions network and set self-service adoption targets.
checks: Adoption targets are set and tracked

days.topic: Advanced Capstone: Global Workday Programme Design
days.lab_task: Present the global Workday programme design to a steering committee with the architecture, global template, security and privacy, integrations and payroll partners, analytics, AI governance, release strategy and support model.
days.deliverable: Programme design with evidence and a steering decision
checks: Conversion, payroll and cutover plans are realistic
AI, release and support governance have owners
